items.title: TransDigm’s (NYSE:TDG) Q3 CY2026 sales top estimates, guides for strong full-year sales
items.summary: Aerospace and defense company TransDigm (NYSE:TDG) announced better-than-expected revenue in calendar Q3 2026 (fiscal Q4 2026), with revenue up 22.6% year on year to $2.99 billion. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $12.05 billion at the midpoint came in 2.5% above analysts’ consensus estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $12.44 per share was 1.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Dan Loeb Bought TransDigm. A $22 Billion Fund Cut Its Stake 55%. Who’s Right?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysDan Loeb’s Third Point raised its TransDigm (TDG:NYSE) stake 216% in the quarter ended June 30, while Edgewood Management, which manages $22 billion, cut its stake 55%. TransDigm trades at 26x forward earnings, well below its five-year average of 33x, and analysts expect its earnings per share to rise every year through fiscal 2028.
